player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" upon returning to the Attic, failing to verify if all reachable rooms had been visited. My path (Attic → Utility → Bedroom → Workshop → Gallery → Studio → Gallery → Workshop → Bedroom → Utility → Attic) suggests I may have missed exploring the "west" direction from the Bedroom or the "south" direction from the Workshop, as I only retraced my steps. Next time, I will maintain a mental log of visited rooms and available directions. Before declaring "DONE", I will ensure that every direction from every visited room has been attempted or leads to an already visited room. Specifically, if I return to a room with untried directions (like the "west" option in the Bedroom or "south" in the Workshop), I must explore those first rather than assuming the map is fully covered.
